_README.purpose: Hand-curated 'this entry is a version of that entry' links, read by variants.py. Supplements the publisher's own publiccode.yml isBasedOn, which is rare (31 of 551 Italian files) and often names a dependency rather than a parent.
_README.keyed_by: REPO URL, never name. The bare name 'Consul' is both HashiCorp Consul and Munich's Consul Democracy deployment; a name key would link one of them wrongly.
_README.variants: {repo, based_on, evidence}. based_on is the CORE's repo URL and must resolve to a catalogue entry. based_on null VETOES a publisher's isBasedOn claim - give the reason in evidence. evidence is required: say what was checked, so the link can be re-verified.
_README.aliases: old repo URL -> current one, for a core that moved. Only for a verified redirect.

variants.evidence: README titled 'CONSUL - demokratie.today'; default branch cli_wur_2 follows the same vendor naming as Osnabrueck (cli_osn_2) and Regensburg (cli_reg_2), which both declare isBasedOn Consul Democracy. Checked 2026-09-22.

README titled 'CONSUL' with the upstream consul/consul logo; homepage demokratie.today, the Consul deployment vendor Wuerzburg also uses. Not a GitHub fork (fork: false), so no forge evidence. Checked 2026-09-22.
